title: First Crossing
core_decision: Learn bridge placement, flood forecasts, and a first boat route.
layout_brief: Bus group of 4 at the west crossing; 4 residents at the low dock; depot and high landing are safe.

event_briefs.description: Reservoir inflow increases; highlight the fork forecast.
Low-dock water rises toward closure threshold.
Final moderate surge tests the placed barrier.

required_objectives_brief: Evacuate at least 6 residents; deliver the bus group to the depot.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 8 and keep the low dock usable until its group boards.
reference_plan_a: Bridge the bus crossing, divert water west, then skiff the dock group.
reference_plan_b: Divert first, skiff the low dock, then build the bridge before the last surge.
failure_explanation: Leaving the dock above the flood threshold too long closes boarding; backup transport recovers the unrescued group.
signature_moment: The first passengers turn and wave as the bridge unfolds.

title: The Lower Road
core_decision: Understand downstream consequences and dry power placement.
layout_brief: Three groups of 4: orchard, river houses, and ferry landing; pump has two legal outlet regions.

event_briefs.description: Rain begins in the upper basin.
A warning reveals the lower-road closure forecast.
Upper inflow peaks; a low generator platform becomes unsafe.

required_objectives_brief: Evacuate at least 9; maintain power at the medical station at mission end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 12 without exposing the orchard assembly point.
reference_plan_a: Put the generator on high ground and pump into the empty basin while the skiff cycles.
reference_plan_b: Use paired barriers to spare the road, ferry the orchard first, and reserve the pump for the late surge.
failure_explanation: An outlet into the orchard transfers the hazard to waiting residents; debrief displays the actual flow path.
signature_moment: A pumping hose visibly bulges while a previously flooded road reappears.

title: Two Banks
core_decision: Allocate transport capacity between separated groups.
layout_brief: West village has 8 residents; east workshop 6. One bridge socket connects only the high paths, not both docks.

event_briefs.description: A central surge closes the low footpath.
Debris blocks one boat lane after a clear warning.
The east landing becomes the shorter remaining route.

required_objectives_brief: Evacuate at least 11; empty the east workshop group.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 14 with no idle fully loaded skiff at the end.
reference_plan_a: Bridge the high road for western pedestrians; use both boats on eastern and overflow groups.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate east early with one skiff, route the other west, then bridge the final safe path.
failure_explanation: A boat assigned to a closing lane waits at a safe node; the player must reassign it.
signature_moment: Two boats cross beneath the viaduct carrying different rescue groups.

title: Power Before Water
core_decision: Trade early protection against immediate evacuation.
layout_brief: Clinic, tram depot, and riverside housing share a power bottleneck. Dry source sockets are scarce but sufficient.

event_briefs.description: First spill enters the clinic basin.
Tram passengers reach the assembly point.
One low connection shuts down unless protected.
Final spill threatens the second basin.

required_objectives_brief: Evacuate at least 12; preserve the clinic power connection at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 16 while keeping both generators operational.
reference_plan_a: Protect the dry power spine and alternate pump assignments to lower both basins.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate riverside first, then dedicate both pumps to the clinic/tram sector.
failure_explanation: Overcommitting power leaves a pump queued; the UI names the inactive consumer.
signature_moment: The town’s lights return in a visible chain when power is restored.

title: The Long Way Home
core_decision: Combine flow, power, routing, and a deliberate equipment tradeoff.
layout_brief: Four groups of 5 occupy the upper village, orchard, workshop, and island landing. Three elevations create alternate safe routes.

event_briefs.description: First surge reveals the main fork.
A forecast landslide closes the short road.
Reservoir overflow increases source flow.
Late inflow tests the downstream basin.

required_objectives_brief: Evacuate at least 15; restore a continuous route between depot and upper village.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 20 and finish with no stranded loaded vehicle.
reference_plan_a: Build the long bridge route, protect generator ground, and ferry the isolated island.
reference_plan_b: Prioritize island and orchard with the skiff, then redirect the late surge and open the land route.
failure_explanation: A poor early diversion consumes safe basin capacity and forces a longer evacuation; no instant unannounced loss.
signature_moment: The final bus and skiff arrive together while the town’s rescue bell rings.

title: A Line in the Trees
core_decision: Learn fuel removal and moisture.
layout_brief: Campsite and lookout connect through two wooded paths; one tank supplies both sprinkler sockets.

event_briefs.description: A marked dry-cell cluster ignites.
Steady wind advances heat toward the short path.
The first cooled strip becomes safe to cross.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 8; preserve a path to the lookout.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 10 while retaining water in the tank.
reference_plan_a: Break the nearest fuel strip and wet the approach.
reference_plan_b: Defend the longer path and stage the campsite first.
failure_explanation: A gap in the firebreak permits predictable spread.
signature_moment: The fire stops along the exact strip the player cleared.

title: Last Bus from Camp
core_decision: Coordinate finite ground transport capacity.
layout_brief: Three camps each hold 6 people; two road loops meet at a refill station.

event_briefs.description: One road becomes threatened.
A wind warning marks the alternate loop.
The refill station approaches heat threshold.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 14; unload every occupied crawler before finishing.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 18 without losing the refill station.
reference_plan_a: Stage one crawler on each loop and protect the common junction.
reference_plan_b: Run both on the nearest camp first, then use the protected longer loop.
failure_explanation: An empty vehicle on the wrong loop costs time but can be rerouted.
signature_moment: Campers board with tiny backpacks and return a lost flag.

title: Water Is a Route
core_decision: Make water supply and transport choices interact.
layout_brief: A pond and storage tank feed separate areas; a pump link can refill the tank without protecting the road by itself.

event_briefs.description: Orchard edge heats.
The tank drops below half unless replenished.
A second ignition threatens the return road.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 12; keep the orchard assembly route usable.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 16 with neither water source exhausted.
reference_plan_a: Pump pond water into the tank and alternate sprinklers.
reference_plan_b: Use firebreaks to minimize wetting and reserve pumped water for the return road.
failure_explanation: A sprinkler without water shows a visible dry gauge rather than pretending to operate.
signature_moment: A hose network creates a brief corridor through a glowing forest edge.

title: When the Wind Turns
core_decision: Anticipate forecast direction changes.
layout_brief: Four groups use a road network with two dominant wind-exposed edges; a fixed powered tank is provided.

event_briefs.description: Wind is stable westward.
A 40-second warning precedes an eastward turn.
A second turn threatens the unprotected flank.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 15; empty the lookout group.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 20 without rebuilding a committed firebreak.
reference_plan_a: Protect both flanks selectively and time transport before the turn.
reference_plan_b: Concentrate early rescues on the future downwind side, then retreat along the safe loop.
failure_explanation: Ignoring the visible wind timeline makes the formerly safe flank dangerous.
signature_moment: Leaves and smoke lean before the route warning changes.

title: The Green Corridor
core_decision: Maintain a living evacuation corridor through a combined burn.
layout_brief: Campsite, orchard, and sawmill each hold 8; two water tanks and one long safe route can support a coordinated solution.

event_briefs.description: Outer forest ignition.
Sawmill access becomes threatened.
Wind shifts toward the central route.
Final heat peak reaches the corridor flank.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 18; preserve the central route at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 24 and save the orchard pump house.
reference_plan_a: Clear a continuous corridor and wet only its vulnerable bends.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate the farthest group first and progressively retreat the transport line.
failure_explanation: Protecting every decorative building leaves too little transport capacity.
signature_moment: The last crawler exits as residents begin planting the first new sapling.

title: Hold the Station
core_decision: Introduce structure-specific support and vertical transfers.
layout_brief: Two terraces connect at the cable station; one known weak support threatens the link.

event_briefs.description: A support begins losing stability.
Meltwater increases load.
A minor tremor tests bracing.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 8; preserve the cable support.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 10 with no station shutdown.
reference_plan_a: Brace the weak support and winch the upper group.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate the upper group early, then stabilize for the remaining transfer.
failure_explanation: Bracing decorative rocks has no effect; only eligible supports accept placement.
signature_moment: Cable tension relaxes visibly when a brace locks into place.

title: Above the Snowline
core_decision: Manage independent rescue links and power.
layout_brief: Three terraces; two winch links and one sheltered intermediate node.

event_briefs.description: Upper path closes under snow.
Sheltered node receives an arriving group.
One unbraced cable platform approaches instability.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 11; empty the top observatory.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 14 without trapping residents at the intermediate node.
reference_plan_a: Run both winches as a staged relay with separate power.
reference_plan_b: Prioritize the observatory, then reuse the lower link for all groups.
failure_explanation: Moving people uphill into a temporary staging node without onward capacity blocks the route.
signature_moment: Tiny lights descend the mountain in two synchronized lifts.

title: The Quiet Slope
core_decision: Read runout zones and preserve a secondary route.
layout_brief: A broad slope threatens one road; a rock shelf provides a longer bypass.

event_briefs.description: Slope stability warning appears.
A marked avalanche runout closes the short road.
Cooling makes one debris edge clearable in the authored route.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 12; evacuate the weather crew.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 16 without entering the marked runout during release.
reference_plan_a: Move the crawler through early and use the shelf afterward.
reference_plan_b: Avoid the short road entirely and stage winch transfers above it.
failure_explanation: A closed road stops vehicles at a safe node; it does not fling rigidbody residents.
signature_moment: A soft wall of stylized snow follows the warned corridor exactly.

title: Cable and Current
core_decision: Combine snow support and flooding power platforms.
layout_brief: A warming lower basin threatens generators while upper cables carry residents.

event_briefs.description: Lower snowmelt starts.
Cable load increases.
A second meltwater source activates.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 14; keep one complete powered cable route available at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 18 while keeping both lower platforms dry.
reference_plan_a: Pump the basin before peak melt and brace the busiest cable.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate the upper terrace before melt peaks, then shift power priority downward.
failure_explanation: Ignoring the lower basin breaks a logically correct upper rescue plan.
signature_moment: A small stream passes beneath the rescued cable line rather than over its power box.

title: Dawn at Frostline
core_decision: Coordinate a complete mountain evacuation.
layout_brief: Observatory, station, and village groups converge through limited safe terraces.

event_briefs.description: Forecast warming begins.
First cable support warning.
Runout closes the valley shortcut.
Final transport window opens at the lower station.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 17; clear the observatory and station groups.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 22 with no occupied vehicle or shelter left behind.
reference_plan_a: Use a vertical relay before the runout, then transfer onto the crawler.
reference_plan_b: Clear the lower village first to free receiving capacity for the mountain groups.
failure_explanation: Using the receiving station as indefinite storage causes a capacity bottleneck.
signature_moment: The sun reaches the restored station as the last cabin arrives.

title: Between Two Tides
core_decision: Learn readable tide windows.
layout_brief: Two islands connect by a low causeway and an all-tide boat route; a fixed dry source powers the receiving dock.

event_briefs.description: Tide begins rising.
Causeway closes.
High landing becomes optimal for unloading.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 9; clear the low-market group.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 12 without a loaded boat waiting at a closed dock.
reference_plan_a: Walk the nearest group early and ferry the late group.
reference_plan_b: Use both boats from the beginning and reserve the bridge for the high route.
failure_explanation: An incorrect dock remains visible but rejects loading with a tide explanation.
signature_moment: Market umbrellas fold as the water reaches the tide ruler.

title: Keep the Light
core_decision: Keep a dry power route while transporting residents.
layout_brief: Three elevated relay sockets can route around a flood-prone connection to the lighthouse.

event_briefs.description: Low cable channel floods.
Receiving dock needs lighthouse power for its safe route signal.
Peak tide threatens the shortest relay path.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 12; power the lighthouse at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 16 with no power outage during final unloading.
reference_plan_a: Build the longer elevated network immediately.
reference_plan_b: Use the short network early, then transfer idle relays to the high sockets before peak tide.
failure_explanation: Moving a relay while its only route is actively required temporarily blocks unloading.
signature_moment: A lighthouse beam returns exactly when the circuit closes.

title: The Floating Market
core_decision: Handle multiple pickups and staging capacity.
layout_brief: Four markets each hold 5; the safe island has limited docks but sufficient total refuge.

event_briefs.description: First tidal lane opens.
A stall pontoon blocks one marked channel.
Current direction favors the outer loop.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 15; unload all occupied skiffs.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 20 without exceeding any staging node capacity.
reference_plan_a: Stagger arrivals through the two receiving docks.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate one island fully, then reuse its high dock as a transfer point.
failure_explanation: Assigning all boats to one dock creates a readable queue, not overlapping models.
signature_moment: Boats line up between colorful awnings and a miniature harbor crane.

title: Storm Switch
core_decision: Combine rain inflow and sea-level changes.
layout_brief: Rain fills an inland basin while tide threatens pump outlets and the power network.

event_briefs.description: Rain source starts.
Tide reduces discharge efficiency.
A brief low-tide window opens.
Final rain peak.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 17; keep the medical landing accessible at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 22 without pumping into the occupied market basin.
reference_plan_a: Store inflow behind a barrier, then pump during low tide.
reference_plan_b: Keep high docks available and prioritize boat evacuation while managing only the critical basin.
failure_explanation: A pump outlet submerged under a tide has reduced effect, clearly shown in its forecast.
signature_moment: Two different water levels become visible across the barrier line.

title: Harbor of Everyone
core_decision: Master transport, tide windows, and power topology.
layout_brief: Three islands, two causeways, four pickup groups, and a lighthouse-backed safe harbor.

event_briefs.description: Rising tide closes the first causeway.
Power warning at the harbor.
Outer route becomes faster with the current.
Last high-water phase closes low docks.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 20; restore lighthouse power and empty every temporary staging dock.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 26 with the high causeway still usable.
reference_plan_a: Prioritize low docks, then use the outer loop for the final groups.
reference_plan_b: Open the high causeway and use boats only for isolated islands while protecting the network.
failure_explanation: Saving the lighthouse alone cannot satisfy the rescue goal.
signature_moment: The harbor fills with rescued boats under a single calm sweep of light.

title: A Path Through Heat
core_decision: Introduce temporary cooled crossings.
layout_brief: Two heat channels divide an orchard from a high landing; one shelter socket lies outside the permanent safe zone.

event_briefs.description: Lava advances into a marked channel.
First cooling opportunity appears.
Cooled segment begins reheating.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 9; empty the temporary shelter before completion.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 12 before the first crossing reheats.
reference_plan_a: Cool a crossing only when residents are ready to move.
reference_plan_b: Stage residents in shelter, cool the longer route, then cross together.
failure_explanation: Cooling too early wastes the safe window; the timer remains visible.
signature_moment: A black crust forms under a cooling plume and opens a narrow path.

title: Borrowed Safety
core_decision: Use refuge as a temporary logistics tool, not a destination.
layout_brief: Two groups need protection while the crawler travels between sectors.

event_briefs.description: Heat advances toward the first assembly point.
Shelter protection starts being consumed.
The outer route opens after a cooling phase.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 14; both temporary shelters empty at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 18 without exhausting a shelter protection interval.
reference_plan_a: Stage one group, evacuate the other, then return along the cooled route.
reference_plan_b: Use both shelters briefly and alternate transport pickups before heat peaks.
failure_explanation: Leaving residents in shelters fails the evacuation condition even if they remain safe.
signature_moment: Shelter lamps change state as the last group boards the crawler.

title: The Cooling Works
core_decision: Protect coolant logistics and power.
layout_brief: A cooling plant supplies finite coolant; water drainage protects its generator and relay.

event_briefs.description: Drainage basin begins filling.
Heat threatens coolant delivery.
A second channel cuts the default route.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 15; keep the cooling works available at end.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 20 while retaining one coolant charge.
reference_plan_a: Secure drainage and power first, then cool the short route.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate via the longer path and save cooling for the late channel.
failure_explanation: Power loss stops production but does not erase stored coolant.
signature_moment: The plant’s pipes light in sequence and a safe corridor opens.

title: Three Ways Out
core_decision: Choose among sea, road, and temporary crossings.
layout_brief: Three sectors support different transport types; all routes share limited final receiving capacity.

event_briefs.description: Road warning.
Heat closes the short land route.
Sea route improves as debris clears.
Final cooling window.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 18; clear the research crew and all temporary refuge.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 24 with no stranded vehicle load.
reference_plan_a: Ferry the coast early, then use crawler and cooling inland.
reference_plan_b: Use shelter to stage inland groups while boats clear the receiving dock.
failure_explanation: Overloading one final landing creates a queue; capacity indicators must predict it.
signature_moment: A boat and crawler transfer groups at the same tiny pier.

title: Every Little Life
core_decision: Final combined-system rescue with meaningful priorities.
layout_brief: Five groups of 6 span an orchard, station, research terraces, waterfront, and high village. No new mechanic is introduced.

event_briefs.description: Rain and heat begin in separate regions.
First transport route warning.
Generator platform needs drainage.
Last heat front approaches the staging zone.

required_objectives_brief: Rescue at least 23; empty all temporary shelters and restore the final ferry route.
mastery_brief: Rescue all 30 without any equipment loss.
reference_plan_a: Stabilize the power/drainage spine, ferry coast groups, and cool the inland route just in time.
reference_plan_b: Evacuate the most exposed groups first, use shelter for the high village, and dedicate late resources to the ferry connection.
failure_explanation: A plan that protects scenery but delays evacuation cannot earn a successful outcome.
signature_moment: Every rescued group joins a single departure; the credits can be skipped without interrupting the final save.
